name: delay_pre_delay
description: Short pre-delay (wet only) — delays the signal feeding a reverb send
notes: 25ms single echo, wet only (send mode, mix 1.0, no feedback): the output is the input delayed by 25 ms with no dry signal. Use by running apply_delay first, then apply_reverb on the delayed output (reverb in send mode), and blend that return with the undelayed dry track. This separates the dry hit from the reverb onset. apply_reverb --pre-delay does the same in one step. Typical pre-delay: 15-30ms for snare, 10-20ms for vocals.
